The main takeaway from our work is that

FSMS implementation is not just a matter of complying with regulations and standards, but also a matter of improving operational and financial performance and enhancing the quality of food supply chain relationships.

FSMS implementation is a critical issue that needs to be considered by the food industry, particularly SMEs, in order to achieve a competitive advantage and to meet the increasing demand for safe food products from consumers.

the success of FSMS implementation in global food supply chain can be achieved by the combination of the efforts of all parties in the supply chains, including the government, food firms, and other parties such as business associations.
